notes: Partition re-checked: all 11 source and 13 target IDs covered exactly once.

The copula joins the predicate יֹתֵר rather than the לְ: the ASV writes no English preposition at all and recasts *man* as the clause's subject, so rule 40 leaves the preposition unrepresented and rule 20 sends the copula to the predicate. The competing rule 49 reading is already named in the unit note.

The articleless participle מַרְבִּים keeps its supplied relative with the attributive itself under rule 41, and the assimilated article before אָדָם is a real token with no *the* written for it (rules 12, 29). The margin's *Or, words* was read and set aside under rule 38.
